questions.question_text: A play starts at $7{:}10$ pm and lasts $2$ hours $5$ minutes. When does it finish?

options.why: Adds the two hours but subtracts five minutes instead of adding them.
Subtracts the duration from the start instead of adding it.
Adds the hours but omits the extra five minutes.

questions.solution_text:
$7{:}10\text{ pm}+2\text{ h}=9{:}10\text{ pm}$
$9{:}10\text{ pm}+5\text{ min}=9{:}15\text{ pm}$

questions.question_text: A tour finishes at $1640$ after lasting $1$ hour $55$ minutes. When did it start?

options.why: Subtracts only 55 minutes and omits the full hour.
Adds the duration to the finish time instead of subtracting it.
Subtracts 45 minutes rather than 55 minutes after removing one hour.

questions.question_text: A meeting runs from $10{:}25$ am to $1{:}05$ pm and includes a $20$-minute break. How much meeting time excludes the break?

options.why: Finds the full elapsed time but does not remove the break.
Adds the break to the elapsed time instead of subtracting it.
Loses one whole hour when bridging across noon.

questions.solution_text:
$10{:}25\text{ am}\to1{:}05\text{ pm}=2\text{ h }40\text{ min}$
$2\text{ h }40\text{ min}-20\text{ min}$
$=2\text{ h }20\text{ min}$

questions.question_text: A coach trip leaves at $2330$, travels for $2$ hours $15$ minutes, then stops for $25$ minutes. When does the stop end?

options.why: Finds the end of the travel period but omits the 25-minute stop.
Adds 25 minutes as though it were 1 hour 10 minutes.
Subtracts the combined duration from the departure time instead of adding it.

questions.question_text: A machine starts at $18{:}35$. It runs for $1$ hour $45$ minutes, pauses for $40$ minutes, then runs for $55$ minutes. When does it finish?

options.why: Adds both running periods but omits the 40-minute pause.
Adds the first run and pause but omits the final 55-minute run.
Adds 25 extra minutes when regrouping the three durations.

questions.solution_text:
$1\text{ h }45\text{ min}+40\text{ min}+55\text{ min}$
$=3\text{ h }20\text{ min}$
$18{:}35+3\text{ h }20\text{ min}=21{:}55$

questions.question_text: A ferry must arrive by $0540$. Sailing takes $2$ hours $48$ minutes and boarding takes $17$ minutes before departure. What is the latest time boarding can begin?

options.why: Finds the sailing departure time but omits the earlier boarding period.
Adds the sailing time to the arrival deadline instead of subtracting it.
